alexa_sales: Heads-up — Helix Therapeutics wants a 6-week POC for their helix-30b-unicode-q4_kv variant. Must-haves: p50 <130ms at 2k context, KV-prefix caching, EU data residency, and FIPS KMS compatibility. They prefer Dedicated but will consider Private. Can SE/Infra/Security do a quick catalog + onboarding fit, rough pricing, and a checklist of blockers?

omar_se: Got it. First things I need: exact tokenizer spec (they mentioned a unicode-aware tokenizer with custom normalization) and a few sample prompts to run a compatibility scan. Does the variant include any custom special tokens?

alexa_sales: They uploaded 60 sample prompts and a tokenizer spec. It uses a "unicode-norm" tokenizer that normalizes certain combining marks differently and adds a <MED_FIELD> special token.

omar_se: Running local scan now:
```
redwood catalog verify --model helix-30b --variant q4_kv --tokenizer unicode-norm --samples ./helix_samples.json
```
I'll check: tokenizer mapping, special token handling, kv-cache behavior, and whether q4 kernel path is supported.

vijay_infra: Perf note: With FIPS they likely can't use fully-hosted unless we integrate BYO-HSM into Dedicated. For p50 <130ms @2k tokens we'll want H100/A100-class Dedicated with aggressive prefix caching. Initial config: 2x H100-equivalents reserved, prefix-cache enabled, batching policy tuned (max-batch=6, latency-slo=35ms).

vijay_infra: Quick cost sketch for 150k tokens/day over 6 weeks: Dedicated (eu-west) w/ POC discount ~ $6.5k total. Private/on-prem install is ~ $22k one-time + support (customer infra excluded). Hosted option without FIPS would be cheaper but fails requirements.

nora_security: FIPS KMS requirement = blocker for fully-managed Hosted. Need to confirm if Helix will accept Dedicated with their customer-hosted FIPS HSM accessible via VPC, or if they require us to manage a FIPS device. Also request: compliance contact, required evidence (FIPS certs, SOC2 excerpts), retention/deletion SLAs, and whether they need HIPAA/BAA.

alexa_sales: They said they need EU residency and FIPS; HIPAA not required. Helix is open to Dedicated + BYO-HSM in their VPC. I'll confirm their compliance contact.

omar_se: Scan results (local):
- tokenizer: normalization differences on combining diacritics; special token <MED_FIELD> present -> adapter required to preserve token mapping
- kv-cache: runtime supports prefix KV-cache for this model variant (no runtime changes)
- quant kernel: q4_kv path uses int8 kernels; supported on Ampere and Hopper, perf projection OK on H100/A100
- estimated adapter work: ~3 hours dev + tests; PR + bench ~1 business day

omar_se: Minimal adapter prototype (python) to normalize codepoints and preserve <MED_FIELD>:
```python
# normalize combining marks and preserve special token
import unicodedata

def normalize_text(s):
    # NFKC normalization then custom combining fix
    t = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', s)
    # placeholder: custom combining adjustments
    t = t.replace('\u0323\u0301', '\u0323\u0301')
    return t.replace('<MED_FIELD>', '<MED_FIELD>')
```

vijay_infra: Action items for infra:
- I'll run a micro-benchmark in eu-west with the q4_kv image + adapter once PR lands (ETA 24h).
- Prepare Dedicated sizing + POC pricing note and variant config (ETA 24h).

nora_security: I'll draft a security scoping note: FIPS implications, BYO-HSM network requirements, logging/audit forwarding, SSO/SAML connectors, and evidence checklist. ETA 48h.

alexa_sales: Sales follow-ups: (1) I'll confirm BYO-HSM details and compliance contact, (2) send the prompt set and tokenizer spec to Omar, (3) confirm retention/deletion requirements.

omar_se: I'll open a short PR with the adapter + unit tests and tag @vijay_infra for benching.

vijay_infra: Also flagging: if Helix asks for p50 <100ms we should recommend 3x reserved capacity and call that out in the proposal.

bench-bot: micro-bench queued (job id: mb-11577). Will post results in this thread when ready.

alexa_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll post the compliance contact and any additional prompts here once I have them. :rocket:
